verdict.rationale: The product documents several per-artifact exports. Flashcards download as CSV, infographics as PNG, and slide decks can be shared as PDF; notes export to Google Docs/Sheets and Audio Overviews can be downloaded for offline playback. Nothing documents a full-account or whole-notebook export that would let a user take all their data and leave. Missing for 10: bulk export of all notebooks, sources and chat history; notes export in an open format rather than Google Docs/Sheets; stated file formats for audio and video downloads; independent confirmation that a complete data exit is possible.
